typography.rules: Never center-align paragraphs. Use tight letter-spacing for all uppercase headings. Ensure maximum contrast. Use Montserrat ExtraBold/Black for high impact.

colors.usage: Use Cream (#F7F4EC) as the primary base. Ink (#141414) is for text, borders, and hard drop shadows. Use the 6 vibrant colors for geometric accents, buttons, and card backgrounds. Avoid gradients entirely; use flat solid colors to maintain the bold geometrical aesthetic.

layouts.spacing_system: Use generous padding: py-24 to py-40 for sections. gap-8 to gap-16 for grids.
layouts.grid_bento: Bento grids with varying column spans for the 'Market Momentum' cards. Grid items must have 2px-4px ink borders.
layouts.section_rules: Avoid perfect symmetry. Use offset alignments. Play with negative space. Elements should occasionally overlap section boundaries to create a continuous festival journey.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Neo-brutalist shadows: shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_rgba(20,20,20,1)]. Hover state: shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(20,20,20,1)] translate-x-[4px] translate-y-[4px].
visual_enhancers.borders: border-2 or border-4 border-[#141414] for interactive elements, image frames, and cards.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Absolute positioned geometric shapes (triangles, semicircles, wavy lines, starbursts) colored in the 6 brand colors scattered across sections with slight z-index variations. Corner framing shapes (pink triangle top-left, teal quarter-circle top-right, amber arc bottom-left) in Hero.
visual_enhancers.image_treatment: Spotlight/clipped frames. Wrap images in divs with hard borders and brutalist shadows, and apply extreme border-radius logic (e.g., rounded-t-full rounded-b-xl, or perfectly circular).

components.nav_bar: Sticky top-0, z-50, cream bg with bottom ink border. Flex layout between geometric PLAYTOPIA logo and Pink 'Register' CTA.
components.button: Rounded-full (pill-shape) or sharp rectangles, bold text, hard ink border, brutalist shadow. Backgrounds predominantly Pink, Teal, or Coral.
components.marquee: Slanted (-rotate-2) infinite marquee ribbon using react-fast-marquee. Thick ink border top/bottom, highly contrasting background (e.g., Coral bg, Ink text).

motion.hero_reveal: Kinetic Hero: Masked line-by-line reveal on load. Wrap text inside overflow-hidden containers, animating y from 100% to 0 with easeInOut over 0.8s.
motion.scroll_animations: Framer Motion 'whileInView' for sections (y: 50 -> 0, opacity: 0 -> 1) with 0.5s duration.
motion.parallax: Floating geometric shapes using useScroll and useTransform to move at different y-speeds as the user scrolls down.
motion.smooth_scroll: Lenis MUST be implemented globally for premium scroll momentum.

accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for Lenis and Framer.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a static, single-page React app using Vite + Tailwind.
Do NOT use Shadcn UI components for layout; rely entirely on custom HTML/Tailwind to achieve the overlapping, brutalist, and asymmetric Memphis style.
Inject framer-motion everywhere: use scroll-based opacity/y translations for sections, and useScroll for parallax on the floating geometric shapes in the hero.
Strictly follow the color palette. DO NOT add generic gray shadows; use ONLY hard brutalist shadows: shadow-[Xpx_Xpx_0px_0px_#141414].
Borders must be solid, thick (2px to 4px) and use #141414.
Do not use generic border radii everywhere. Mix hard squares, circles, and arches (rounded-t-full) to frame images.
Use react-fast-marquee for the editorial ribbon.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Do not build any backend forms. Use placeholder '#' or alert() for Register buttons.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Add specific transitions for interactives.
NEVER use emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
Do not center-align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Ensure micro-animations on hover states for every button/link. For this brand, that means depressing the brutalist shadow.
